title: 요즘 많이 추워졌어요: 달라진 것 말하기 (-어지다)
objective: By the end, you can add -아지다/-어지다/-해지다 to adjectives to describe a change, and add -어지다 to some verbs to say what was done to something, using 이/가 correctly.
summary: Learn -어지다 to say how something has changed, such as 추워졌어요, and to say what was done to something, such as 만들어졌어요.

task.title: Use -어지다 correctly
task.line: Read each item, then fill in the blank, choose the right word, or put the words in order.

forms.when: The last vowel of the stem is ㅏ or ㅗ.
forms.exampleMeaning: I took medicine, and my cold got much better.

forms.when: The last vowel of the stem is not ㅏ or ㅗ.
forms.exampleMeaning: As summer came, the days got longer.

forms.when: The stem ends in ㅂ. For most of these adjectives (춥다, 덥다, 쉽다), ㅂ changes to 워. Some are regular (좁다 → 좁아졌어요), and 곱다 becomes 고와졌어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Now that it's November, it suddenly got cold.
The students went home, so the classroom got quiet.

forms.when: With some verbs (만들다, 지우다, 정하다, 알리다). The thing that the action happens to takes 이/가.
forms.means: to be done (to something). The focus is on the thing, not the person who did it.
forms.exampleMeaning: This cup is made of paper.

watchOut: 춥어졌어요 (X) → 추워졌어요 (O): For most adjectives ending in ㅂ, ㅂ changes to 워. (쉽다 → 쉬워졌어요; but 좁다 → 좁아졌어요)
바쁘어졌어요 (X) → 바빠졌어요 (O): When the stem ends in ㅡ, the ㅡ drops before -아/어.
글씨를 지워졌어요 (X) → 글씨가 지워졌어요 (O): With a passive -어지다 verb, use 이/가, not 을/를.
따뜻해 졌어요 (X) → 따뜻해졌어요 (O): Write -어지다 together with the word, with no space.
exercises: Fill in the blank with 작다 + -어지다 (past tense): 이 바지가 저한테 좀 ____.
Fill in the blank with 덥다 + -어지다 (past tense): 에어컨이 고장 나서 사무실이 ____.
Choose the correct form: ① 한국 생활이 (익숙해졌어요 / 익숙하어졌어요). ② 그 이야기를 듣고 마음이 (슬퍼졌어요 / 슬프어졌어요). ③ 비가 와서 길이 (위험해졌어요 / 위험하졌어요).
Fill in the blank with 정하다 + -어지다 (past tense): 다음 주 회의 시간이 아직 안 ____.
Choose the right particle: ① 그 소식(이 / 을) 학생들에게 벌써 알려졌어요. ② 반장이 회의 날짜(가 / 를) 정했어요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: [가벼워졌어요 / 가방이 / 책을 빼니까]
answers: ① 익숙해졌어요 ② 슬퍼졌어요 ③ 위험해졌어요
